origin.description: Classify each test row by a majority vote of its k nearest training labels.
origin.usage: knn(train, test, cl, k=1, prob=FALSE, algorithm=c("kd_tree", "cover_tree", "brute"))
origin.details: Ties in the vote keep the first maximum after the labels are sorted. The result is a dict with class, prob, nn.index, and nn.dist.
origin.example: two-class train of six points, test (1.1, 1.1) and (5.5, 9.2), k=2, prob TRUE

translation.description: knn votes with the first maximum. Character labels are sorted. The result carries class, prob, nn.index, and nn.dist.
translation.usage: knn(train, test, cl, k=1, prob=False, algorithm=None)
translation.details: Ties in the vote keep the first maximum after the labels are sorted. The result is a dict with class, prob, nn.index, and nn.dist.
translation.example: two-class train of six points, test (1.1, 1.1) and (5.5, 9.2), k=2, prob TRUE
